browser: isolated headless Chromium (Playwright) plus direct production HTTP requests

stories.result: Production returned 800 real Fal records and rendered 718 grouped/stacked card elements with no error state.

Search reduced the rendered groups from 718 to 8 for 'krea'; category and name-sort controls rerendered populated results. The prior instanceof failure was a malformed harness evaluation, not an app defect.
Production returned and rendered 250 real Replicate records with populated metadata.
Category and sort can rerender, but typing a search term throws because filterReplicateModelsData calls toLowerCase() on nullable description/owner fields; the visible list remains unfiltered at 250.
Production returned and rendered 347 real OpenRouter models with provider, architecture, context, and pricing data.
Searching 'gemini' reduced the catalog from 347 to 22 rendered cards. The prior instanceof failure was a harness error rather than an app defect.
Production returned and rendered 120 real Hype items with source, score, author, and timestamp fields.
Top Ranked changed the first item from stable-diffusion to sdxl-lightning-4step and updated the status to sorted by rank; the earlier unchanged-order report was stale/weak evidence.
Production returned 500 posts (662 upstream total) and rendered 500 populated cards with dates, summaries, read times, and outbound links.
Oldest sort changed the first card from a current post to Rodin Gen 1.5 (2 years ago) and updated the result label to sorted oldest first.
Production v11 replaced the prior 404: preview/full requests return 200 and the UI renders 360 TestingCatalog articles with no failed request or error banner.
All 360 returned records contain tags: []; the tag selector therefore has only its single default option, so tag filtering cannot be used despite the story contract.
Production day feed rendered 3 real current updates and the week endpoint returned 51 real updates; source counts and item payloads are populated rather than hard-coded empty success.
The control exposes exactly Last 24 hours/day and Last 7 days/week; include_hype is honored by the endpoint, and the preview response is explicitly marked preview=true.

A valid /dashboard?section=blog URL activates and displays Blog, but links generated by the app use location.origin + '/?section=...', whose root page is blank in Sites. Invalid section fallback itself is safe.

The shared-view POST/GET storage lifecycle succeeds with a valid category/items snapshot, but copyShareableLink generates origin-root URLs instead of retaining /dashboard, producing a blank recipient page.

A created view persisted and restored its exact state/snapshot through the API, but the generated /?view=<id> recipient URL lands on the blank root instead of /dashboard?view=<id>, making UI restoration unreachable from the copied link.
Clicking a populated LLM card opened the typed analysis modal with title, overview, OpenRouter, and AI Analysis tabs; the close control removed it.

Cross-source lookup returned HTTP 402 without provider entitlement and the modal truthfully displayed 'OpenRouter lookup failed.' rather than fabricated match data. This is an explicit key/entitlement boundary, not a UX defect in this lane.
LLM JSON export downloaded llms-export.json containing 570 real records (645700 bytes) with model evaluation, performance, creator, name, and pricing fields.
Pinning the first visible LLM card and exporting produced pinned-items.json with one correctly keyed item. The earlier timeout targeted a hidden card after an overlay and was a harness artifact.

discovered_errors.title: Replicate search crashes on nullable model fields
discovered_errors.evidence: Production page error: Cannot read properties of null (reading 'toLowerCase') at static/script.js filterReplicateModelsData; search input remains populated while all 250 cards stay visible.
discovered_errors.expected: Search should normalize nullable name, description, and owner fields and render only matching records.

discovered_errors.title: Testing Catalog records have no tag metadata
discovered_errors.evidence: Production /api/testing-catalog returned 360 items, all with tags: []; the UI tag selector contained one default option only.
discovered_errors.expected: The backend should populate tags/sections from upstream data or the unusable tag-filter control should be removed/reframed.

discovered_errors.title: Generated direct/share links omit the deployed /dashboard pathname
discovered_errors.evidence: copyShareableLink builds location.origin + '/?section=...' and '/?view=...'; production root renders an empty body, while /dashboard?section=... is functional.
discovered_errors.expected: Generated URLs must preserve the deployed dashboard pathname so recipients can open sections and restore saved snapshots.
